Khazix.escape: The moment after Kha'Zix E Leap is used to engage is a chance to close the distance with Nidalee W Pounce. While Kha'Zix R Void Assault is active, don't chase his position or engage alone; wait near allies and counterattack as soon as he appears. Nidalee W Pounce can also cross terrain to escape, so keep an exit route open.
Khazix.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear, W Void Spike, and E Leap. Kha'Zix W Void Spike also heals him, so fit in Morellonomicon to prevent him from recovering between fights and denying your Nidalee Q Takedown finishing opportunity.
Khazix.combo: Hit Kha'Zix with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to apply the hunt mark, then transform with Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. Close in with empowered Nidalee W Pounce, finish with Nidalee Q Takedown within basic attack range, then deal the remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. If the spear misses, don't force this sequence.
Khazix.fight: Avoid direct fights where Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear can hit you while you're isolated, and first lower his health with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range. Close the distance with Nidalee W Pounce after the spear hits and applies the hunt mark, or after Kha'Zix E Leap has been used to engage. If you miss the spear, you won't have empowered Pounce or a Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar reset, so don't force the approach.
Khazix.laning: Gank lanes where an ally can lock down the enemy first, and stay close to others to avoid Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear's isolated damage. If there are no such lanes, focus on farming and pressuring the enemy jungle, but don't let Kha'Zix figure out where you're pathing alone. Place Nidalee W Bushwhack on river entrances and jungle forks ahead of time to track his path.
Khazix.phase: Early on, use Nidalee's fast jungle clear and spear poke to pressure Kha'Zix's jungle and objectives before his first evolution. Even during Nidalee's strong mid game, stop acting alone if Kha'Zix has gained two or more evolutions. Late game, your impact drops if you can't land the spear, so find an angle from the side and only go in to finish.
Khazix.teamfight: Group with allies in a narrow area where you have vision to prevent Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear from dealing isolated damage. Use Nidalee W Bushwhack to watch approach routes, and lower enemies' health with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the side. Enter in cougar form to finish with Nidalee Q Takedown only after the enemy's key damage dealer has lost enough health, then escape with Nidalee W Pounce.
Khazix.watch: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear deals much more damage when you are isolated, so stay near allies or minions. Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat adds a slow and bonus damage to his basic attack after he returns from being out of sight, so secure vision in brush ahead of time. If Kha'Zix disappears with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, watch for his likely approach route and use the moment he reappears as a chance to counterattack.

Amumu.phase: Mid game is when Nidalee is at her strongest, but avoid front-to-front fights where Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy can catch you. In late game, your presence drops if you can’t hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss, so first find an angle to land it from long range.
Amumu.combo: Hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to apply the Hunt mark and get the Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar reset, then transform into a cougar. Close in with empowered Nidalee W Pounce, enter basic attack range, use Nidalee Q Takedown, and deal the remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. If the spear misses, don’t force this engage combo.
Amumu.laning: Nidalee has no crowd control, so start by ganking lanes where an ally can lock down the enemy. If there are no such lanes, seek an early advantage through farming and invading the enemy jungle. Place Nidalee W Bushwhack at river entrances and jungle intersections to track Amumu’s path, and stand behind minions in lane to avoid Amumu Q Bandage Toss.
Amumu.watch: If Amumu Q Bandage Toss hits you, you’ll be stunned and caught, and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy can then immobilize you as well. Keep your distance while Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is available, spread out from allies, and avoid fighting in narrow passages. Amumu W Despair continuously deals damage based on your max health at close range, so use Nidalee W Pounce to manage the distance.
Amumu.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Amumu’s damage is mostly magic, and Nidalee has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Amumu W Despair deals damage based on your max health, so avoid choices that greatly increase health alone.
Amumu.escape: Look for an engage after Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is down. Amumu has no ability to create distance on his own, so if he has the Hunt mark, close the gap and chase with Nidalee W Pounce. When you need to retreat, use Nidalee W Pounce to leap over terrain, then return to human form and create distance.
Amumu.fight: In human form, hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to chip away at health and apply the Hunt mark before going in. If the spear misses, you won’t get empowered Nidalee W Pounce or the Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar reset, so don’t force an engage. Don’t fight head-on for long while Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is available.
Amumu.teamfight: While Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is available, spread out from allies and keep your distance in open terrain. In human form, throw Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the side or behind. Only go in as a cougar after Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is down and an enemy key damage dealer’s health has been reduced sufficiently. After finishing them, escape with Nidalee W Pounce. Just before an objective fight, cast Nidalee E Primal Surge on an allied damage dealer.

Belveth.build: Build armor first to defend against the physical damage from Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom. Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet deals true damage that resistances can’t block, so build health as well. If Bel'Veth’s healing costs you a kill opportunity, work Morellonomicon into your build.
Belveth.teamfight: Don’t engage head-on. Apply your mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the flank or behind, then enter in cougar form to finish only when the main damage dealer has lost enough health. Deal damage as Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom ends, then escape with Nidalee W Pounce. If an ally dies and leaves a Void Coral, retreat before Bel'Veth picks it up, and delay the team fight while Bel'Veth is transformed by Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet.
Belveth.combo: Hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from a distance in human form to mark your hunt, then transform with Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. Close in with empowered Nidalee W Pounce, enter basic attack range, finish with Nidalee Q Takedown, and deal the remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. If your spear misses or Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is spinning, don’t force the combo.
Belveth.escape: Dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below sideways and wait for an opportunity to engage after checking the direction Bel'Veth Q Void Surge just traveled. Q has a separate cooldown for each direction, but her mobility comes back often, so don’t go deep just because one direction is down. Save Nidalee W Pounce for your escape.
Belveth.fight: Poke from a distance with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss to chip away at health and apply the Hunt mark, then engage. When Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom starts, don’t unload your combo while its damage reduction is active; wait until it ends, then finish with Nidalee Q Takedown. Avoid long head-on fights, as Bel'Veth W Above and Below can catch you.
Belveth.laning: Place Nidalee W Bushwhack at river entrances and jungle crossroads to track Bel'Veth’s pathing. Gank lanes where an ally can lock down the enemy, and otherwise gain an advantage through jungle farming and invades.
Belveth.phase: Early on, before Bel'Veth builds stacks, Nidalee has a chance to get ahead by invading and pressuring camps. The mid game, as Nidalee builds ability power, is her strong phase, so turn long-range spear hits into fights. In the late game, Bel'Veth gains an advantage from her permanent stacks, and Nidalee’s impact drops if she misses spears.
Belveth.watch: Bel'Veth W Above and Below knocks you up and slows you if it hits, while also giving Bel'Veth another chance to use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. When Bel'Veth closes in, dodge W by turning sideways instead of running straight back. Don’t use Nidalee Q Takedown while Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is spinning; wait for it to end.

Gragas.fight: Harass from range with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss, and hold your burst while Gragas W Drunken Rage is being channeled. The moment after Gragas E Body Slam is down is your chance to close the gap, but don’t force it if you haven’t hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss. Use Nidalee Q Takedown to finish an enemy with low health.
Gragas.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Gragas’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If Gragas P Happy Hour’s healing makes you miss a chance to finish him between fights, fit Morellonomicon into your build.
Gragas.combo: Hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to apply the Hunt mark, then transform with Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. Close in with empowered Nidalee W Pounce, enter basic attack range, finish with Nidalee Q Takedown, and deal the remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. Go all in after Gragas W Drunken Rage’s damage reduction ends.
Gragas.escape: Right after making Gragas use Gragas E Body Slam, if you apply the Hunt mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss or Nidalee W Bushwhack, go in with Nidalee W Pounce. Delay your engage if Gragas E Body Slam is still available or you’re within Gragas Q Barrel Roll’s radius. Gragas E Body Slam may come back during the chase, so pursue deep only when you can finish him for certain.
Gragas.laning: Nidalee has no crowd control to lock down an enemy, so start by ganking allied lanes that have it. Place Nidalee W Bushwhack in advance at river entrances and jungle intersections to track Gragas’s path. If no lane is suitable for a gank, gain an advantage through farming and invading the enemy jungle.
Gragas.phase: Early on, Nidalee clears the jungle quickly and can pressure objectives with spear harass, but avoid taking Gragas’s early and mid game burst head-on. Mid game, when Nidalee’s ability power has built up, is her peak, so look for a fight after hitting a spear. Gragas’s sustained damage weakens in late game, but Nidalee also falls off if she can’t hit a spear, so focus on landing one first.
Gragas.teamfight: Take a position to throw Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the side or behind; don’t engage from the front. Don’t leave your allied backline alone within range of Gragas E Body Slam. If it hits, immediately move outside Gragas Q Barrel Roll’s radius. Enter as a cougar and finish an enemy key damage dealer after they have lost enough health, then escape with Nidalee W Pounce.
Gragas.watch: When you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll, leave its radius immediately. If Gragas E Body Slam hits you near the barrel, you’ll take damage from both abilities, so avoid brush you have no vision of and narrow choke points. When Gragas R Explosive Cask is available, don’t stand with your back to an enemy turret or the enemy team.

Fiddlesticks.watch: Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm channels before entering and dealing area damage, so when you see it cast, use Nidalee W Pounce to get out of its range. If you’re hit by Fiddlesticks’s abilities from out of sight, you can be feared, so watch bushes and narrow entrances when Fiddlesticks has been out of sight for a long time. Standing in the center of Fiddlesticks E Reap also silences you, so avoid the middle of your formation.
Fiddlesticks.build: In the early game, withstand his damage with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Fiddlesticks deals mostly magic damage, and Nidalee has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Fit Morellonomicon into your build to counter the healing from Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest.
Fiddlesticks.combo: Hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to apply the Hunt mark, then transform with Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. Close in with empowered Nidalee W Pounce, enter basic attack range, finish with Nidalee Q Takedown, and deal the remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. If you miss the spear, you’ll have neither the empowered engage nor the Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar reset, so don’t force the combo.
Fiddlesticks.escape: If Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and E Reap are also down, apply the mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss and close the gap with Nidalee W Pounce. Don’t go deep without a way to escape; if you’re in danger, use Nidalee W Pounce to leap over terrain and get out.
Fiddlesticks.fight: Don’t get caught by Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and E Reap and then take Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm; if you miss your spear, don’t force an engage with Nidalee W Pounce. Don’t fight while taking the channel from Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest either; reposition and restore your distance.
Fiddlesticks.laning: Nidalee has no crowd control, so start by ganking lanes where an ally can lock down the enemy. If there are no such lanes, gain an advantage through farming and invading the enemy jungle. Keep vision in the brush behind your lanes to prepare for Fiddlesticks’s unseen ambush, and don’t walk close to a stationary Fiddlesticks P A Harmless Scarecrow before checking it.
Fiddlesticks.phase: Mid game, when Nidalee’s ability power has built up, is her peak, so look for a chance to finish after hitting a spear. In late game, your presence drops if you can’t hit a spear, so look for an opportunity to land one from the side instead of fighting head-on.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, E Reap, and R Crowstorm all deal area damage, so spread out from allies and don’t group in narrow areas without vision. Secure vision in the brush in front of objectives and along the approach routes, then apply a mark to a key damage dealer with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the side. Only go in as a cougar and finish with Nidalee Q Takedown after the target’s health has been sufficiently reduced, then escape with Nidalee W Pounce.

MonkeyKing.build: Build armor first to prepare for Wukong’s main damage. However, Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces your armor and Wukong E Nimbus Strike deals magic damage, so don’t prolong a fight with him relying on armor alone. Work Morellonomicon into your build to counter healing from Wukong P Stone Skin.
MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong E Nimbus Strike is targeted and cannot be dodged, so stay out of its range and watch for the follow-up where Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces your armor. When Wukong W Warrior Trickster appears, don’t use Nidalee Q Javelin Toss on the clone left in place; watch the direction the real Wukong will escape.
MonkeyKing.combo: Hit the real Wukong with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to apply the hunt mark, then transform with the reset Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. Close in with empowered Nidalee W Pounce, enter basic attack range, finish with Nidalee Q Takedown, and deal the remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. If the spear misses or only hits Wukong W Warrior Trickster's clone, don't force the approach.
MonkeyKing.escape: The chance to close the distance with Nidalee W Pounce comes before Wukong W Warrior Trickster returns after being used. Check whether Wukong E Nimbus Strike is also down, and delay your engage if Wukong R Cyclone is still available, since you could be knocked up. After finishing him, escape with Nidalee W Pounce.
MonkeyKing.fight: Nidalee's main magic damage is effective against Wukong's low magic resistance, so apply brief pressure from a distance with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss. Wukong builds armor and healing as hits accumulate, so don't stay in a prolonged fight. Before Wukong W Warrior Trickster comes back up, close in with Nidalee W Pounce on the real Wukong after hitting him with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss and finish quickly.
MonkeyKing.laning: Nidalee has no crowd control, so gank lanes where an ally can lock down the enemy first. Place Nidalee W Bushwhack on river entrances and jungle forks ahead of time to track Wukong's path. If there is no gank opportunity, farm the jungle and look for an advantage by invading the enemy jungle while avoiding direct fights with Wukong.
MonkeyKing.phase: Early on, pressure with Nidalee's fast jungle clear and spear poke, but avoid direct fights where you can be caught. Mid game, when your ability power is building, is Nidalee's strong point, so look for brief trades while Wukong's mobility is down. Late game, your presence drops if you can't hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss, so first find an angle to land it from long range.
MonkeyKing.teamfight: While Wukong R Cyclone is available, spread out from allies to avoid being knocked up together. From the side or behind, apply the mark to the real Wukong with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss, and enter in cougar form to finish only after the enemy's key damage dealer has lost enough health. Look for an objective or fight just after Wukong R Cyclone is down, and escape with Nidalee W Pounce after engaging.

Brand.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Brand’s main damage is magic, and Nidalee has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Brand.combo: In human form, hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to apply the Hunt mark, then transform with Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. Close in with empowered Nidalee W Pounce, enter basic attack range, finish with Nidalee Q Takedown, and deal the remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility, so the moment after Brand W Pillar of Flame is down is your chance to close the gap. Brand Q Sear won’t stun you when Blaze is absent; if you’re burning, dodge the projectile before engaging. Nidalee W Pounce can also be used to escape, so keep an exit in mind when you go in.
Brand.fight: When Brand W Pillar of Flame is down, look for an angle to hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range. Once the mark is applied and Brand’s health has been sufficiently reduced, close in with Nidalee W Pounce and finish him. If you miss the spear, you won’t have the empowered effect, so don’t force an engage.
Brand.laning: Stand to the side of the wave to avoid being harassed by Brand E Conflagration spreading from a burning minion. Nidalee has no crowd control, so gank lanes where an ally can lock down the enemy first. If there are no such lanes, gain an advantage through farming and invading the enemy jungle.
Brand.phase: Mid game, when your ability power has built up, is Nidalee’s peak, so capitalize on opportunities after hitting a spear. In late game, your presence drops if you can’t hit a spear, so don’t rush your engage.
Brand.teamfight: Spread out from allies so Brand E Conflagration and Brand R Pyroclasm don’t spread, and don’t stand near burning allies. Instead of engaging from the front, apply a mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the side or behind. Go in as a cougar only after a key damage dealer’s health has been sufficiently reduced, finish them, then escape with Nidalee W Pounce.
Brand.watch: After Brand P Blaze is applied to you, getting hit by his next ability builds stacks and causes an explosion, so focus on dodging the initial hit from Brand Q Sear or Brand W Pillar of Flame. Brand Q Sear stuns you if it hits while you’re burning, so get out of the projectile’s path. If you see Brand R Pyroclasm, spread out from your allies.

Briar.build: Briar’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Briar P Crimson Curse, W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, and E Chilling Scream restore her health. Once you have resistances, fit Morellonomicon into your build if the fight goes long.
Briar.combo: Hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to apply the Hunt mark, then transform with Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. Close in with empowered Nidalee W Pounce, enter basic attack range, finish with Nidalee Q Takedown, and deal the remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. If you miss the spear, you won’t have the empowered effect or R reset, so don’t force this engage sequence.
Briar.escape: Don’t go in just because Briar Q Head Rush is down; also check Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and R Certain Death. In particular, close the gap with Nidalee W Pounce when Briar has used her dash and stun, before Briar R Certain Death comes back. Keep an escape route in mind so you can use Nidalee W Pounce to retreat after engaging.
Briar.fight: If you encounter Briar in the jungle, use Nidalee Q Javelin Toss to chip away at health and aim to gain an advantage by delaying her next move. If you miss the spear, don’t force a close fight; if it hits, check her remaining dashes and stun before engaging. Don’t fight with a wall behind you while Briar E Chilling Scream is charging.
Briar.laning: Nidalee has no crowd control, so start by ganking lanes where an ally can lock down Briar. Get vision in lanes you’ve pushed so you can punish Briar if she attempts an aggressive gank. Don’t linger in the middle of a lane when the area has no vision.
Briar.phase: Early on, Nidalee clears the jungle quickly and can pressure objectives with her spear, but Briar also has high early kill participation, so avoid a head-on fight. Mid game, as Nidalee’s ability power builds, use Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to chip away at health first and look for an opening to engage. In late game, your influence drops if you can’t hit a spear, so avoid forcing an engage.
Briar.teamfight: Apply a mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the side or behind instead of engaging from the front. Have your allied frontline stand in the path of Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, and fight back together if Briar R Certain Death targets an ally. Only transform with Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar and finish off an enemy key damage dealer after their health has been sufficiently reduced, then escape with Nidalee W Pounce.
Briar.watch: Briar Q Head Rush dashes in and stuns while reducing armor and magic resistance, so keep your distance to avoid it. When Briar E Chilling Scream is charging, move away from positions with a wall behind you. If Briar R Certain Death hits you and makes you her prey, move toward your allies and fight back together instead of trying to escape alone.

Diana.build: Diana’s main damage is magic, and Nidalee has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots.
Diana.combo: Hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to apply the Hunt mark, then transform with Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. Close in with empowered Nidalee W Pounce, enter basic attack range, finish with Nidalee Q Takedown, and deal the remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. If Diana W Pale Cascade is active, wait until its shield and orbs are gone before engaging.
Diana.escape: If Diana enters first with Diana E Lunar Rush without hitting Diana Q Crescent Strike, the moment after she uses E is your chance to close the gap. If you were hit by the Q mark, E may reset, so don’t engage; create distance with Nidalee W Pounce. Keep Pounce available as an escape if you’re in a position where Diana R Moonfall can pull you in.
Diana.fight: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss deals more damage from long range, so move between brush to find an angle. Trade after Diana W Pale Cascade’s orbs and shield are gone, and close the gap with Nidalee W Pounce if Diana uses Diana E Lunar Rush without a Q mark. If you miss the spear, don’t force an engage expecting an empowered Pounce.
Diana.laning: Nidalee has no crowd control, so start by ganking lanes where an ally can lock down the enemy.
Diana.phase: Mid game, when Nidalee’s ability power has built up, is her strong period, but don’t fight Diana head-on because Nidalee has low health and magic resistance. In late game, your influence drops if you can’t hit a spear, so look for an angle to apply the mark from long range.
Diana.teamfight: Spread out from allies so Diana R Moonfall doesn’t pull in several of you, and use vision to check side approach routes. Nidalee shouldn’t engage from the front; apply a mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the side or behind. Only finish in cougar form after a key damage dealer’s health has been sufficiently reduced, then escape with W Pounce.
Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves through the air and leaves a mark, so dodge sideways instead of retreating in a straight line. If it hits, Diana E Lunar Rush may have its cooldown reset, so create distance immediately. Don’t approach right after Diana W Pale Cascade is activated; wait until its shield and orbs disappear.

Ekko.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Ekko’s main damage is magic, and Nidalee has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If Ekko R Chronobreak’s healing makes you lose a chance to finish him between fights, fit Morellonomicon into your build.
Ekko.combo: Hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to apply the Hunt mark, then transform with the reset Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. Close in with empowered Nidalee W Pounce, enter basic attack range, use Nidalee Q Takedown to try to finish him, and deal the remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. If Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, keep track of his afterimage and don’t rush to finish him.
Ekko.escape: If only Ekko E Phase Dive is down, don’t rush in because Ekko can escape with Ekko R Chronobreak. Avoid Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s stun area and, before Ekko R Chronobreak becomes available again, close the gap with Nidalee W Pounce against Ekko while he has the Hunt mark. Nidalee W Pounce can also be used to escape, so plan a route out after engaging.
Ekko.fight: Avoid Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s area while first chipping away at health with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range. Once both Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are down and the mark is applied, close in with Nidalee W Pounce. If you miss the spear, you won’t have the empowered effect, so don’t force an engage.
Ekko.laning: Nidalee has no crowd control, so start by ganking lanes where an ally can lock down the enemy. Place human-form Nidalee W Bushwhack in advance at river entrances or jungle intersections to track Ekko’s path, then look to chase if he steps on one and gets the Hunt mark. If there’s no gank angle, gain an advantage through farming and invading the enemy jungle.
Ekko.phase: Mid game, when Nidalee’s ability power has built up, is her peak, so actively look for opportunities when Ekko R Chronobreak is down. In late game, your influence drops if you can’t hit a spear, so first find an angle to land it from long range.
Ekko.teamfight: Nidalee shouldn’t engage from the front; apply a mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the side or behind. Right after Ekko enters with Ekko E Phase Dive, he has no mobility available, so capitalize on that opening if an ally can stun or root him. Only go in as a cougar and finish an enemy key damage dealer after their health has been sufficiently reduced, then escape with Nidalee W Pounce.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, stay out of the marked area to avoid its stun and shield. Watch the direction Ekko Q Timewinder travels and also move out of its return path. If you see Ekko’s afterimage, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so don’t chase recklessly even if health is low.

Elise.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first, and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Elise’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If Elise P Spider Queen’s healing makes you miss a chance to finish her between fights, fit Morellonomicon into your build.
Elise.combo: Hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to apply the Hunt mark, then transform with the reset Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. Close in with empowered Nidalee W Pounce, enter basic attack range, finish with Nidalee Q Takedown, and deal the remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. If you miss the spear, you won’t have the empowered effect, so don’t force an engage.
Elise.escape: The moment after both Elise E Cocoon and Elise E Rappel are down is your chance to turn the fight around. You can also close the gap with Nidalee W Pounce right after making Elise use Elise Q Venomous Bite, but don’t spend every Pounce on engaging; save one to escape.
Elise.fight: Don’t approach first from the front; harass from long range with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss. Even after hitting the spear and applying the Hunt mark, check whether Elise E Cocoon and Elise E Rappel are down before engaging. Watch for Elise R Spider Form after her health has been reduced, and save Nidalee Q Takedown to finish her.
Elise.laning: Early on, keep ample vision to prepare for Elise’s ganks, and don’t push your lane recklessly when Elise is missing. Place Nidalee W Bushwhack in advance at river entrances and jungle intersections to track her path. Prioritize ganking lanes where an ally can lock down the enemy.
Elise.phase: Early on, Elise will try to build an advantage through ganks, so avoid giving up kills and don’t fight her head-on. Nidalee is strong in mid game as her ability power builds, so create opportunities with spear harass. In late game, your influence drops if you can’t hit a spear, so look for a chance to land it instead of forcing an engage.
Elise.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front; in human form, throw Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the side or behind to apply the mark. Only enter in cougar form and finish a key damage dealer after their health has been sufficiently reduced, then escape with Nidalee W Pounce. Being caught by Elise E Cocoon is dangerous, so position away from its path.
Elise.watch: Use minions or jungle monsters as cover to dodge Cocoon. When Elise switches to R Spider Form, she’s looking to finish you, so create distance with Nidalee W Pounce.

Evelynn.build: Since Evelynn's main damage is magic, build magic resistance first and buy a Null-Magic Mantle early. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Evelynn P Demon Shade restores her health between fights, so fit in Morellonomicon as well.
Evelynn.combo: Hit with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from afar to apply the Hunt mark, then transform with Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. Use empowered Nidalee W Pounce to get within basic attack range, cast Nidalee Q Takedown, and deal the remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. If your spear misses, you won't have an empowered engage, so don't force it.
Evelynn.escape: Engage before Evelynn R Last Caress becomes available again and when you've avoided the charm from Evelynn W Allure. If only Evelynn E Whiplash is down, she can still escape with another mobility tool, so don't spend all your Nidalee W Pounce on engaging; leave yourself a way out.
Evelynn.fight: While the mark from Evelynn W Allure is building, don't engage first with Nidalee W Pounce; create distance instead. Hit Evelynn with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from afar to apply the Hunt mark, then go in as a cougar after Evelynn's health has been chipped away and finish with Nidalee Q Takedown.
Evelynn.laning: Place Nidalee W Bushwhack on river entrances and jungle intersections, and ward beside the jungle camps where Evelynn might start a fight. Try ganking lanes where an ally can lock down the enemy first.
Evelynn.phase: Mid game, when your ability power has built up, is Nidalee's peak, so apply pressure with spear poke and jungle invades. In the late game, Nidalee's impact falls if Nidalee Q Javelin Toss doesn't hit, so look for an angle to apply the mark first.
Evelynn.teamfight: Don't go in head-on; look for an angle to land Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the side or behind, where your allies have vision. Use Nidalee E Primal Surge on the backline carry Evelynn is targeting to grant healing and attack speed, and make sure there's room to retreat if you see the mark from Evelynn W Allure. Go in as a cougar to finish only after the key target's health has been sufficiently reduced and the Hunt mark is applied, then escape with Nidalee W Pounce.
Evelynn.watch: When you see the mark from Evelynn W Allure, back off before the charm completes and alert your allies. When your health is low, watch out for the empowered damage from Evelynn R Last Caress.

Graves.build: Get Plated Steelcaps early and build armor first to counter Graves's main damage. Armor won't block the magic damage from Graves W Smoke Screen, but armor takes priority against the damage mix described here.
Graves.combo: Hit with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from afar to apply the Hunt mark, then transform with the reset Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar and approach with empowered Nidalee W Pounce. Get within basic attack range, cast Nidalee Q Takedown, and deal the remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. If your spear misses, you can't count on empowered Pounce or a form-change reset, so don't engage.
Graves.escape: When both Graves E Quickdraw and Graves R Collateral Damage are down, apply the mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss and engage. If Graves W Smoke Screen hits you, use Nidalee W Pounce to get out of its area and recover your vision, then decide whether to fight again. Nidalee W Pounce is also for escaping, so don't spend it all on engaging.
Graves.fight: Create distance in open terrain and look for an angle to hit with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss; if it misses, don't force an engage. Counterattack or create distance again while Graves reloads after firing two shots. In close fights, put minions or allies between you and Graves to block his basic attacks.
Graves.laning: Nidalee should gank lanes where an ally can lock down the enemy first. If there are no such lanes, look for gains through farming and invading the enemy jungle, but don't fight Graves head-on. Place Nidalee W Bushwhack on river entrances and jungle intersections in advance to track Graves's path and apply pressure from the early game.
Graves.phase: Early on, use Nidalee's fast jungle clear and spear poke to limit the time Graves has to scale. Mid game, when your ability power has built up, is Nidalee's peak, so use spear hits as an opportunity. Graves gets stronger over time, and Nidalee's impact falls late if her spear doesn't hit, so avoid direct fights.
Graves.teamfight: Don't go in head-on; aim to mark Graves and other enemies with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the side or behind. Don't fight by walls where Graves Q End of the Line can detonate immediately or inside Graves W Smoke Screen. Transform with Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar to finish only after the key carry has lost enough health, then escape with Nidalee W Pounce.
Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line detonates immediately when it hits terrain, so don't fight with your back to a wall or in a narrow jungle passage. If Graves W Smoke Screen traps you, your vision is blocked and you're slowed; get out by the shortest route, then look for another angle. Graves E Quickdraw grants armor and magic resistance and lets him create distance, so even right after he uses it, check whether Graves R Collateral Damage is still available.

Hecarim.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Hecarim Q Rampage and Hecarim E Devastating Charge. Hecarim W Spirit of Dread heals him, so fit in Morellonomicon.
Hecarim.combo: Hit with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from afar to apply the Hunt mark, then transform with Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. Approach with empowered Nidalee W Pounce, get within basic attack range, then finish with Nidalee Q Takedown and deal the remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. If your spear misses, you won't have the empowered effect or the Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar reset, so don't force the engage.
Hecarim.escape: Don't engage just because Hecarim E Devastating Charge is down. The opportunity comes when Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows is also down and hasn't returned yet; apply the Hunt mark then and close the gap with Nidalee W Pounce. After engaging, keep Nidalee W Pounce in mind as a way to escape too.
Hecarim.fight: Don't fight Hecarim head-on for long; look for an angle to hit with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from afar.
Hecarim.laning: Nidalee has no crowd control, so gank lanes where an ally can lock down the enemy first. If there are no such lanes, look for gains through farming and invading the enemy jungle.
Hecarim.phase: Nidalee is strongest in mid game, when her ability power has built up, so take short fights after hitting with your spear. In the late game, her impact falls if her spear doesn't hit, so don't rush into an engage.
Hecarim.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so several of you aren't caught by Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows. Nidalee should apply the mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the side or behind, and only go in as a cougar to finish after the enemy team's key carry has lost enough health.
Hecarim.watch: Hecarim E Devastating Charge deals more damage and knocks back farther the greater the distance he has run, so when Hecarim creates distance and starts running, escape with Nidalee W Pounce or move toward your allies. Keep your distance from allies so several of you aren't feared together by Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows.

Ivern.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first early on and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Ivern deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance; tenacity also matters in situations where you are caught by Ivern Q Rootcaller and Ivern R Daisy! before allies join.
Ivern.combo: Hit with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from afar to apply the Hunt mark, then transform with the reset Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. Approach with empowered Nidalee W Pounce, get within basic attack range, then finish with Nidalee Q Takedown and deal the remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. If your spear misses, you won't have the empowered effect, so don't force this engage sequence.
Ivern.escape: If a target is already affected by Ivern E Triggerseed, wait for it to burst. Don't spend all of Nidalee W Pounce on engaging so you can escape afterward.
Ivern.fight: Chip away at the enemy's health first with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from afar, and don't force an engage if it misses. Go in after Ivern Q Rootcaller is down and Ivern E Triggerseed has burst, and target the ally Ivern shields before targeting Ivern himself.
Ivern.laning: Place Nidalee W Bushwhack on river entrances and jungle intersections in advance to track Ivern's path. Ivern plants seeds on camps and returns to harvest them, so use early jungle vision to check his route. Try ganking lanes where an ally can lock down the enemy first, and don't casually walk beside Ivern W Brushmaker when it suddenly appears.
Ivern.phase: Early on, Nidalee clears the jungle quickly in cougar form, and you can track Ivern's route back to harvest his camps. However, Nidalee is vulnerable when caught, so avoid head-on fights with the enemy jungler. Mid game, when her ability power has built up, is Nidalee's peak; in the late game, focus on hitting with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss.
Ivern.teamfight: Don't go in head-on; apply the mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the side or behind. Ivern R Daisy! can block your spear, so don't throw it at an enemy behind Daisy. Go in as a cougar to finish only after the enemy team's key carry has lost enough health and Ivern Q Rootcaller is down, then escape with Nidalee W Pounce.
Ivern.watch: If you're rooted by Ivern Q Rootcaller, Ivern's allies can charge in, so position yourself with minions or terrain in between before firing. Don't jump straight onto a target affected by Ivern E Triggerseed; avoid the slow left when its shield bursts. When Ivern R Daisy! starts hitting you, move away to stop her chained attacks from knocking you up.

JarvanIV.combo: Hit with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from afar to apply the Hunt mark, then transform with Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. Approach with Nidalee W Pounce, then finish with Nidalee Q Takedown when the target's health has decreased and deal the remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. If your spear misses, you won't have the empowered effect, so don't force your way in.
JarvanIV.laning: Nidalee has no crowd control, so help lanes where an ally can lock down the enemy first; otherwise, gain an advantage through farming and invading the enemy jungle.
JarvanIV.teamfight: Nidalee shouldn't go in head-on; apply the mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the side or behind.

Jax.combo: Hit with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from afar to apply the Hunt mark, then transform with Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. If Jax E Counter Strike has ended and Jax Q Leap Strike is also down, approach with Nidalee W Pounce and deal damage with Nidalee E Swipe. When Jax's health has decreased, finish with Nidalee Q Takedown within basic attack range.
Jax.escape: When Jax E Counter Strike activates, move out of its stun range and save Nidalee W Pounce so you can use it to escape. After Jax Q Leap Strike and E Counter Strike are down, that's your chance to hit with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss and go in.
Jax.fight: Deal damage in short bursts and create distance before Jax P Relentless Assault builds up his attack speed. After Jax E Counter Strike is down, apply the Hunt mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss, then engage once you've confirmed Jax has also used Jax Q Leap Strike. Don't use Nidalee Q Takedown while Jax E Counter Strike is active.
Jax.laning: Nidalee has no crowd control, so gank lanes where an ally can lock down Jax first. Also watch for minions and wards Jax can use as targets for Jax Q Leap Strike.
Jax.phase: Mid game is Nidalee's peak, when her ability power has built up; in the late game, her impact falls if her spear doesn't hit.
Jax.teamfight: From the side in human form, throw Nidalee Q Javelin Toss. If Jax enters with Jax E Counter Strike active, leave its stun range and wait for it to end. Transform with Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar to finish only after the enemy team's key carry has lost enough health, then escape with Nidalee W Pounce. Don't group near Jax and get caught together by the area stun from Jax E Counter Strike.
Jax.watch: Jax E Counter Strike negates basic attacks and the damage attached to them, then stuns in an area when it ends. Stop basic attacking when Jax E Counter Strike activates and move out of its stun range. Jax can close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike, so keep Nidalee W Pounce as an escape tool.

Karthus.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first early on and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Karthus deals mostly magic damage, and Nidalee has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Karthus.combo: In human form, hit with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from afar to apply the Hunt mark, then transform with the reset Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. Approach with empowered Nidalee W Pounce, then cast Nidalee Q Takedown within basic attack range and deal the remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe.
Karthus.escape: Karthus has no skill to create distance himself, so engage after dodging the warning area of Karthus Q Lay Waste and going around Karthus W Wall of Pain. Nidalee W Pounce is also for escaping, so don't spend it all on engaging; keep some for your escape.
Karthus.fight: Hit with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from afar to apply the Hunt mark, then engage. Approach along a path that avoids Karthus W Wall of Pain, and minimize the time you spend in Karthus E Defile. If your spear misses, you won't have the empowered effect, so don't force an engage.
Karthus.laning: Nidalee has no crowd control, so help lanes where an ally can lock down the enemy first. If there are no such lanes, gain an advantage through farming and invading the enemy jungle instead of ganking.
Karthus.phase: Mid game, when your ability power has built up, is Nidalee's peak, so use hits from Nidalee Q Javelin Toss at long range as an opportunity. In the late game, Nidalee's impact falls if her spear doesn't hit, so avoid forcing an engage.
Karthus.teamfight: Don't go in head-on; apply the mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the side or behind. Use Nidalee W Pounce to go in and finish only after the key carry has lost enough health, then get out. If you've killed Karthus, reposition immediately to avoid the damage that follows from Karthus P Death Defied.
Karthus.watch: Passing through Karthus W Wall of Pain reduces your magic resistance and slows you, making the following Karthus Q Lay Waste and R Requiem more dangerous. Go around the wall and walk out of the indicated blast area of Karthus Q Lay Waste. Right after killing Karthus, move away from his corpse to avoid the spells cast through Karthus P Death Defied.

Kayn.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Kayn Q Reaping Slash, W Blade's Reach, and R Umbral Trespass. If Kayn has transformed into the Darkin and healing makes fights drag on, get healing reduction with Morellonomicon. Since Kayn Q Reaping Slash deals damage based on your maximum health, avoid choices that greatly increase only your health.
Kayn.combo: Hit with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from afar to apply the Hunt mark, then transform with Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. Approach with empowered Nidalee W Pounce, get within basic attack range, then aim to finish with Nidalee Q Takedown and deal the remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. If your spear misses, don't force this engage.
Kayn.escape: Avoid Kayn W Blade's Reach; the chance to engage comes before Kayn R Umbral Trespass returns. If only Kayn Q Reaping Slash is down, don't rush in without considering his remaining mobility. When an opportunity opens, apply the mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss or W Bushwhack, then close the gap with Nidalee W Pounce.
Kayn.fight: Pressure Kayn's jungle route while he's weak before transforming, but avoid dueling him head-on because Nidalee is fragile. When Kayn uses Kayn E Shadow Step to pass through a wall, damage him with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss to shorten its duration. If your spear misses, don't force a chase with Nidalee W Pounce without an empowered follow-up.
Kayn.laning: Nidalee has no crowd control, so gank lanes where an ally can lock down the enemy first. Place Nidalee W Bushwhack on river entrances and jungle intersections in advance to track Kayn's path; if he steps on a trap, chase using the Hunt mark. If you see the warning indicator for Kayn E Shadow Step in a lane, retreat instead of continuing to trade damage.
Kayn.phase: Early on, Kayn is weak before transforming, so use Nidalee's fast jungle clear and spear poke to pressure his path and objectives. Nidalee is strong in mid game, when her ability power has built up, so open favorable fights after hitting with a spear from afar. In the late game, her impact falls if her spear doesn't hit, so avoid engaging head-on and weaken enemies first.
Kayn.teamfight: Nidalee should apply the mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the side or behind, and go in as a cougar to finish only after the key carry has lost enough health. Keep Nidalee W Pounce as an escape tool too, so you can avoid being caught by Kayn W Blade's Reach. An ally caught by Kayn R Umbral Trespass can't be helped for its duration, so look for an opening for Nidalee's spear and cougar attacks after Kayn emerges near the target.
Kayn.watch: Dodge the line of Kayn W Blade's Reach to avoid being caught by its slow or knockup and reduce the risk of a follow-up Kayn R Umbral Trespass from afar. Kayn Q Reaping Slash dashes in and deals damage based on your maximum health, so don't fight him head-on. If the warning indicator for Kayn E Shadow Step appears along a wall, stop fighting and retreat toward your turret.

Kindred.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and Kindred E Mounting Dread. If healing from Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy and Kindred R Lamb's Respite makes the duel drag on, fit in Morellonomicon.
Kindred.combo: Hit Kindred with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to apply the hunt mark, then transform with Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar and approach with empowered Nidalee W Pounce. At basic attack range, look to finish with Nidalee Q Takedown and deal the remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. If the spear misses, you won't have empowered Pounce or a transformation cooldown reset, so don't force the approach.
Kindred.escape: When only Kindred Q Dance of Arrows is down, Kindred can still escape with Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy, so don't rush your engage. In particular, before Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy comes back up, hit with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss and close the distance with empowered Nidalee W Pounce. If Kindred E Mounting Dread is on you, stop engaging and use Nidalee W Pounce to retreat.
Kindred.fight: Hit Kindred with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to lower their health and apply the hunt mark, then engage. If Kindred E Mounting Dread is on you, don't stand and fight; use Nidalee W Pounce to create distance. If you have a chance to get close before Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy is placed, burst briefly and back off.
Kindred.laning: Nidalee has no crowd control, so gank lanes where an ally can lock down the enemy first. If there is no gank opportunity, farm the jungle while placing Nidalee W Bushwhack on river entrances and jungle forks to track Kindred's path. Delay Kindred P Mark of the Kindred progress by taking marked jungle camps first or securing vision nearby.
Kindred.phase: Early on, pressure Kindred's Mark of the Kindred camps with Nidalee's fast jungle clear and spear poke, but avoid direct fights. Mid game, when your ability power is building, is Nidalee's strong point, so look for openings using marks and vision. Late game, your impact falls if you can't hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss, so prioritize landing the spear over forcing an engage.
Kindred.teamfight: Don't approach head-on. From the side or behind, lower Kindred's health with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss, finish in cougar form, then escape with Nidalee W Pounce. If Kindred R Lamb's Respite is active, enter the zone so you can also save low-health allies, and time your finish around the healing when the zone ends. Don't chase Kindred for long inside Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy.
Kindred.watch: Kindred E Mounting Dread can deal heavy damage with consecutive attacks, and is more dangerous when your health is low. Use Nidalee W Pounce to create distance or break vision in brush to avoid follow-up attacks. Kindred often uses Kindred Q Dance of Arrows inside Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy, so don't fight there for long.

LeeSin.build: Build armor first against the damage from Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, Q Resonating Strike, and Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. Armor can't block the magic damage from Lee Sin E Tempest and E Cripple. If Lee Sin W Iron Will restores his health during a long fight, consider anti-heal.
LeeSin.combo: In human form, hit with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to apply the hunt mark. Transform with Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar, close in with empowered Nidalee W Pounce, then use Nidalee Q Takedown within basic attack range and follow with Nidalee E Swipe. If the spear misses, you won't have the empowered effect or an R reset, so don't force the engage.
LeeSin.escape: The chance to engage comes when Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave misses and Lee Sin W Safeguard is also down. Apply the mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss, then close the distance with Nidalee W Pounce. If Lee Sin still has a mobility ability, don't chase just because you drew one ability out.
LeeSin.fight: Avoid direct duels with Lee Sin in the early jungle. Hit him with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to apply the hunt mark, and look to engage after Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave misses. If Lee Sin W Safeguard is also down, close in with Nidalee W Pounce and deal brief burst damage.
LeeSin.laning: Nidalee has no ability to lock down an opponent, so gank lanes where an ally can do so first. If you expect a Lee Sin gank, put minions or jungle monsters between you to block the straight path of Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave. If there is no gank opportunity, seek an advantage by farming and invading the enemy jungle.
LeeSin.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early duels, so back off if you encounter him and look for an advantage with Nidalee's fast jungle clear and spear poke. Mid game, when your ability power is building, is Nidalee's peak, so actively look for angles to land the spear. Lee Sin falls off late, but Nidalee's impact also drops if you can't land the spear, so build advantages around objectives and lanes as you fight.
LeeSin.teamfight: Don't go in head-on as Nidalee. From the side or behind, apply the mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss. Enter in cougar form to finish only after the enemy's key damage dealer has lost enough health, then escape with Nidalee W Pounce. Keep some distance from allies in anticipation of Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage, and position so that being kicked sends you toward your allies.
LeeSin.watch: If Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave hits you, Lee Sin can dash in with Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike, which deals more damage the more health you've lost. If your health falls to half or below while Sonic Wave is on you, retreat toward allies while Q Resonating Strike is available. Keep your distance from walls, since Lee Sin can cross over one with Lee Sin W Safeguard from beyond your vision.

Lillia.build: Lillia deals mostly magic damage, and Nidalee's magic resistance is relatively low, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Fit in Morellonomicon so healing from Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough doesn't take away your chance to finish her.
Lillia.combo: Hit Lillia with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to apply the hunt mark, then transform with Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. Follow with empowered Nidalee W Pounce to approach, use Nidalee Q Takedown at basic attack range to finish, then deal the remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. If you miss the spear, you won't have the empowered effect or a form-switch cooldown reset, so don't force this sequence.
Lillia.escape: The moment after you make Lillia use Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is a chance to approach with Nidalee W Pounce. Dodge Lillia's poke abilities and engage when she has no movement speed stacks; also keep in mind that you need Nidalee W Pounce to get back out. If Lillia R Lilting Lullaby affects you, move to a safe place during the drowsy period before you fall asleep.
Lillia.fight: Look for an angle to hit Lillia with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range before she lands abilities and builds movement speed. If the spear misses, don't force an approach; dodge Lillia's abilities and wait until she has no movement speed stacks. Right after Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is used, look for a chance to close the distance with Nidalee W Pounce.
Lillia.laning: Nidalee has no crowd control to lock down opponents, so help lanes where an ally can do so first when ganking. If there are no such lanes, look for an advantage by farming and invading the enemy jungle. Place Nidalee W Bushwhack on river entrances and jungle forks ahead of time to track Lillia's path.
Lillia.phase: Mid game, when your ability power is building, is Nidalee's peak, so look for chances to engage after landing the spear. Late game, your presence drops if you can't hit the spear, and it's hard to chase Lillia once she builds movement speed stacks with her abilities.
Lillia.teamfight: Don't approach head-on. From the side or behind, apply the mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss. Save your allies' immobilizing crowd control for Lillia in case she comes in from the side. Transform with Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar to finish only after the enemy's key damage dealer has lost enough health, then escape with Nidalee W Pounce.
Lillia.watch: Being hit by Lillia Q Blooming Blows or Lillia E Swirlseed enables Lillia R Lilting Lullaby to put you to sleep, so avoid them even when your health is high. Be mindful of Lillia E Swirlseed and don't enter narrow jungle corridors when you don't know where Lillia is. When you see Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! begin casting, move sideways to avoid the center hit.

MasterYi.build: Resistance can't reduce the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style, so build health as well. If Master Yi W Meditate restores his health, you may lose your chance to finish with Nidalee Q Takedown, so fit in Morellonomicon.
MasterYi.combo: In human form, hit with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to apply the hunt mark, then transform with the reset Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. Close in with empowered Nidalee W Pounce, finish with Nidalee Q Takedown within basic attack range, then deal the remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. If Master Yi is using Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, save your finisher until he lands.
MasterYi.escape: Immediately after Master Yi's only mobility tool, Q Alpha Strike, has been spent, you have a chance to close the distance with Nidalee W Pounce. After engaging, save Nidalee W Pounce to get out, and cross terrain to escape if things get dangerous.
MasterYi.fight: Hit Master Yi with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to lower his health and apply the hunt mark, then engage. If the spear misses, you won't get empowered Pounce or a Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar reset, so don't force the approach. Close the distance when Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is down, but use Nidalee Q Takedown only after Master Yi lands and his health has decreased.
MasterYi.laning: Nidalee has no crowd control, so gank lanes where an ally can lock down the enemy first. If there are no such lanes, slow Master Yi's growth by farming, invading the enemy jungle, and pressuring early objectives. Even though Master Yi is weak early, avoid direct fights because Nidalee is in danger if she gets caught.
MasterYi.phase: Master Yi is weak in the early jungle, so Nidalee can build an early lead with fast jungle clears, spear poke, and objective pressure. Mid game, when your ability power is building, is Nidalee's peak, so look for chances to finish after landing the spear. The longer the game goes, the stronger Master Yi becomes, while late-game Nidalee's presence drops if she can't hit the spear.
MasterYi.teamfight: As Nidalee, don't approach head-on. From the side or behind, apply the mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss. Enter in cougar form to finish only after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends and the enemy's key damage dealer has lost enough health, then escape with Nidalee W Pounce. Nidalee has no crowd control to interrupt Master Yi W Meditate, so save your allies' immobilizing crowd control for that moment and respond together to prevent Master Yi from participating in a takedown.
MasterYi.watch: Master Yi can't be targeted while casting Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, so use Nidalee Q Takedown just after he lands. Watch out for the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style and his fast pursuit while Master Yi R Highlander is active, and create distance along terrain before he catches you.

Nocturne.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Nocturne P Umbra Blades, Nocturne Q Duskbringer, and Nocturne R Paranoia. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror. If Nocturne P Umbra Blades lets him recover health between fights, work Morellonomicon into your build.
Nocturne.combo: After Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is down, land Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range. When the hunt mark resets Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar’s cooldown, transform into cougar form and close in with empowered Nidalee W Pounce. Once you’re in basic attack range, use Nidalee Q Takedown on Nocturne after his health has decreased, then deal the remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. If your spear misses, you won’t have the empowered effect, so don’t force your way in.
Nocturne.escape: If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror and Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness are both down, apply your mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss, then engage with Nidalee W Pounce. While the fear can still trigger, save Nidalee W Pounce as a way to create distance.
Nocturne.fight: Don’t fight head-on for long; first reduce Nocturne’s health with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from a distance. Enter in cougar form when Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is down and your spear has hit to mark your hunt. Leave a path to escape with Nidalee W Pounce in case of Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
Nocturne.laning: Nidalee has no crowd control, so gank lanes where an ally can lock down the enemy first. Place Nidalee W Bushwhack in advance at river entrances and jungle crossroads to read Nocturne’s pathing, then chase if he steps on one and gets marked. If you’re hit by Nocturne Q Duskbringer, turn toward an ally or turret instead of retreating in a straight line along the trail.
Nocturne.phase: Nidalee peaks in the mid game as her ability power builds, so look for fights after landing a spear. In the late game, missing Nidalee Q Javelin Toss reduces your presence, so create distance first and find a clear angle to land it.
Nocturne.teamfight: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens the screen, don’t move alone; immediately group with your allies. Avoid a head-on engage and apply your mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the flank or behind. Only enter in cougar form to finish after the main damage dealer has lost enough health and Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is down, then escape with Nidalee W Pounce.
Nocturne.watch: If you’re hit by Nocturne Q Duskbringer, Nocturne can chase you quickly along the trail it leaves, so turn toward an ally or turret instead of running straight away. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror connects, use Nidalee W Pounce to create distance and break the tether before the fear triggers. Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness blocks one ability and greatly increases his attack speed if it blocks one, so don’t throw Nidalee Q Javelin Toss while his shield is active.

Nunu.build: Nunu & Willump deal mostly magic damage, and Nidalee's magic resistance is low, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. Nunu & Willump Q Consume restores health, so fit in Morellonomicon early to preserve your chance to finish them.
Nunu.combo: Hit Nunu & Willump with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to apply the hunt mark, then transform with Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. Approach with empowered Nidalee W Pounce, use Nidalee Q Takedown within basic attack range, and deal the remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. If you miss the spear, don't force this engage combo.
Nunu.escape: The chance to engage comes after dodging Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and getting clear of the root threat from E Snowball Barrage. Nunu & Willump have no ability to create distance themselves, so if Nidalee Q Javelin Toss applies the mark, close the distance with Nidalee W Pounce. If Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero begins, Nidalee has no crowd control to interrupt it, so leave its area.
Nunu.fight: Nunu & Willump can heal between fights with Nunu & Willump Q Consume, so hit them with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to lower their health and look for a finishing angle. If the spear misses, you won't have empowered pursuit either, so don't force the approach. Engage after dodging the crowd control from Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and E Snowball Barrage.
Nunu.laning: Place Nidalee W Bushwhack on river entrances and jungle forks ahead of time to track their path, and watch for the possibility that Nunu & Willump will return for another gank immediately after a snowball gank. Nidalee has no crowd control, so try ganking lanes where an ally can lock down the enemy first.
Nunu.phase: Mid game, when your ability power is building, is Nidalee's peak, so use vision and traps to track their path and look for chances after landing a long-range spear. Late game, your presence drops if you can't hit the spear, so don't rush your engage.
Nunu.teamfight: Don't approach head-on. From the side or behind, apply the mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss. Enter in cougar form to finish with Nidalee Q Takedown only after the enemy's key damage dealer has lost enough health, then escape with Nidalee W Pounce. If Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero is active, don't fight inside it; move out of range.
Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! rolls in from far away and knocks you up, so watch for the moment they approach from outside river vision. Instead of running from the snowball, walk toward it and escape through the space Nunu & Willump came from. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, use Nidalee W Pounce to move away before the follow-up root triggers.

Poppy.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on max health, so don't greatly increase only your health, and don't spend resources specifically on magic resistance because of Poppy alone.
Poppy.combo: In human form, hit Poppy with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to apply the hunt, then transform with Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. Once Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends, close in with Nidalee W Pounce, enter basic attack range, use Nidalee Q Takedown, then deal the remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. If the spear misses, you won't have the empowered effect or a Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar reset, so don't force the approach.
Poppy.escape: The moment after you make Poppy use Poppy E Heroic Charge is a chance to close the distance. Confirm that Poppy W Steadfast Presence has also ended before going in with Nidalee W Pounce, and account for the leap you'll need to escape.
Poppy.fight: Hit Poppy with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range, then look for an angle to engage using the hunt mark. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, don't use Nidalee W Pounce; wait for its short duration to end. Even when Poppy is low on health, her armor and magic resistance increase, so only engage when your finishing damage is certain.
Poppy.laning: Before ganking the lane against Poppy, first check whether an ally can lock down the enemy. Place Nidalee W Bushwhack on a river entrance or jungle fork ahead of time to track Poppy's path, and look for a chase angle if she steps on the trap and is hunted. During a fight, stand toward open space so Poppy E Heroic Charge can't push you into a wall.
Poppy.phase: Early on, pressure with Nidalee's fast jungle clear and spear poke, but avoid direct fights where Poppy can catch you. Mid game, when your ability power is building, is Nidalee's peak, so make use of openings created by landing the spear. Late game, your presence drops if you can't hit the spear, so don't rush your engage.
Poppy.teamfight: Don't approach head-on. In human form, throw Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the side or behind. Enter in cougar form to finish only after Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends and the enemy's key damage dealer has lost enough health. Since a single crowd control effect can get you killed, escape with Nidalee W Pounce after finishing.
Poppy.watch: If you leap in with Nidalee W Pounce while Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, the dash is blocked and you can't use movement abilities briefly. Stand in open space, since Poppy E Heroic Charge can stun you against a wall. If Poppy Q Hammer Shock hits you, walk out of the area before the second hit triggers, and move sideways out of the front of Poppy R Keeper's Verdict when she charges it.

Rammus.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Rammus’s main damage is magic, and Nidalee has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Rammus.combo: Hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to apply the Hunt mark, then transform with the reset Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. Close in with empowered Nidalee W Pounce, get into basic attack range, then finish with Nidalee Q Takedown and deal your remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. If Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, delay your engage until its duration ends.
Rammus.escape: When Rammus R Soaring Slam is down, hitting Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from outside Rammus E Frenzying Taunt range creates an opportunity to engage. Rammus E Frenzying Taunt prevents you from moving or using abilities, so calculate your engage distance to ensure you can escape with Nidalee W Pounce as soon as it ends.
Rammus.fight: Hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to apply the Hunt mark, then decide whether to engage. If Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, back off and concentrate your damage the moment it ends. If your spear misses or you are within Rammus E Frenzying Taunt range, don’t force your way in with Nidalee W Pounce.
Rammus.laning: Nidalee has no crowd control, so gank lanes where an ally can lock down the opponent first. Place human-form Nidalee W Bushwhack in advance at river entrances and jungle forks to track Rammus’s path. Keep a minion between you and him and maintain your distance along the route where Rammus Q Powerball is approaching.
Rammus.phase: Nidalee peaks in the mid game as her ability power builds, so look to land a spear and catch the window when Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl ends. In the late game, Nidalee’s presence falls off if she can’t hit her spear, so prioritize finding a good angle over forcing an engage.
Rammus.teamfight: Don’t go in head-on. Throw Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the side or behind in human form. When you see Rammus Q Powerball, back away from the larger area of Rammus R Soaring Slam and leave the landing point too. Go in with Cougar form to finish only when the enemy’s main damage dealer has lost enough health, then escape with Nidalee W Pounce.
Rammus.watch: When you see Rammus Q Powerball, keep a minion between you and him and stay outside Rammus E Frenzying Taunt range. While Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, his defenses are high and basic attacks against him trigger reflected damage, so stop attacking. If Rammus Q Powerball lets him close the gap quickly, move well clear of Rammus R Soaring Slam’s area, then immediately leave the landing point too.

RekSai.build: Prioritize armor against the physical damage from Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath and Rek'Sai R Void Rush. Rek'Sai E Furious Bite deals true damage that resistances can’t reduce, and Rek'Sai R Void Rush scales with your maximum health, so be careful about relying on a large amount of health alone. Rek'Sai P Fury of the Xer'Sai restores her health, so include Morellonomicon in your build.
RekSai.combo: In human form, hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to apply the Hunt mark. Transform with the reset Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar, close in with empowered Nidalee W Pounce, finish with Nidalee Q Takedown from basic attack range, then deal your remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. Don’t force this engage if your spear misses.
RekSai.escape: Avoid the knock-up from Rek'Sai W Un-burrow. Once Rek'Sai E Tunnel is down, you have an opportunity to go in with Nidalee W Pounce. Rek'Sai can escape if Rek'Sai R Void Rush is still available, so look to engage before that ability comes back. Also account for having Nidalee W Pounce available to escape after you go in.
RekSai.fight: Poke down Rek'Sai with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range instead of fighting up close. If your spear misses, you won’t have empowered Nidalee W Pounce or the Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar reset, so don’t force your way in. Don’t give Rek'Sai space to heal while Burrowed, but keep dodging Rek'Sai W Un-burrow as you continue dealing damage.
RekSai.laning: Watch for Rek'Sai’s early ganks: don’t push your lane recklessly or move alone through areas without vision. Walk over visible tunnel entrances to remove Rek'Sai E Tunnel’s gank routes and escape routes. Nidalee has no crowd control, so gank lanes where an ally can lock down the opponent first.
RekSai.phase: In the early game, avoid giving Rek'Sai kills from ganks and avoid fighting head-on. Nidalee peaks in the mid game as her ability power builds, so make use of long-range spear poke and opportunities to finish opponents. In the late game, Nidalee’s presence falls off if she can’t hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss, so don’t rush your engage.
RekSai.teamfight: Don’t engage head-on; apply the Hunt mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the side or behind. Go in as Cougar only when the main damage dealer has lost enough health, finish with Nidalee Q Takedown, then escape with Nidalee W Pounce. Avoid narrow paths in front of a Burrowed Rek'Sai so Rek'Sai W Un-burrow doesn’t catch you.
RekSai.watch: When Rek'Sai is Burrowed, watch out for the knock-up from Rek'Sai W Un-burrow. Avoid walls and narrow paths, and move toward open space with Nidalee W Pounce when she emerges. Immediately after being hit by Rek'Sai’s ranged poke, stay close to allies because Rek'Sai R Void Rush may follow.

Rengar.build: Prioritize armor against Rengar’s main damage. Rengar W Battle Roar heals him, so include Morellonomicon in your build to preserve opportunities to finish him with Nidalee Q Takedown.
Rengar.combo: Hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to apply the Hunt mark, then transform with Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. Close in with empowered Nidalee W Pounce until you’re in basic attack range, finish with Nidalee Q Takedown, and deal your remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. Starting this sequence after Rengar W Battle Roar is down reduces the risk that his healing will remove your opportunity to finish him.
Rengar.escape: After dodging Rengar E Bola Strike, engage with Nidalee W Pounce or use it to create distance. Once Rengar goes in, he has no ability to create distance himself, so the moment Rengar W Battle Roar is also down is an opportunity to hit your spear and engage. Don’t use Nidalee W Pounce solely to engage; keep it available to get out.
Rengar.fight: Trade after Rengar’s resource bar is empty and Rengar W Battle Roar is down. Hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to apply the Hunt mark, and only then go in with Nidalee W Pounce. If your spear misses, don’t force your way in without the empowered chase.
Rengar.laning: Avoid paths beside bushes when Rengar is out of sight, and use a Control Ward to get vision of the bushes. Nidalee has no crowd control, so gank lanes where an ally can lock down the opponent first. If there’s no such lane, look for an advantage by farming the jungle and invading the enemy jungle.
Rengar.phase: Nidalee peaks in the mid game as her ability power builds, so use the Hunt mark when Rengar’s abilities are down. In the late game, Nidalee’s presence falls off if she can’t hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss, so create distance first and find an angle for your spear.
Rengar.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and within vision to limit Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt’s opportunity to leap onto your backline. Cast Nidalee E Primal Surge on an allied damage dealer just before an objective fight to provide healing and attack speed. Don’t go in head-on; apply the Hunt mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the side, and go in as Cougar to finish only when the main damage dealer has lost enough health, then escape with Nidalee W Pounce.
Rengar.watch: Rengar P Unseen Predator lets him leap from bushes, and his next ability is empowered when his resource bar is full. When Rengar is out of sight, avoid paths beside bushes and move with Nidalee W Pounce after dodging Rengar E Bola Strike. Don’t roam alone while injured when Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt is active.

Sejuani.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Sejuani’s main damage is magic, and Nidalee has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Sejuani.combo: Hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to apply the Hunt mark, then transform with Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. If Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down, close in with empowered Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce, finish with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss / Takedown, and deal your remaining damage with Nidalee E Primal Surge / Swipe. If your spear misses, you won’t get the empowered effect or the form-switch cooldown reset, so don’t force your way in.
Sejuani.escape: Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is her mobility tool, so right after she uses it is an opportunity to close the gap with Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce. If you’re stunned by Sejuani E Permafrost, create distance as soon as it wears off to avoid her basic attack immediately afterward.
Sejuani.fight: Bait out Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, then hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to apply the mark and engage. If you’re hit by the first strike of Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath, create distance before the second strike with Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce. Don’t fight up close while Sejuani E Permafrost stacks are building.
Sejuani.laning: Nidalee has no crowd control, so gank lanes where an ally can lock down the opponent first. Place Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce traps in advance at river entrances and jungle forks to track Sejuani’s path. If there’s no gank opportunity, gain an early advantage by farming the jungle and invading the enemy jungle.
Sejuani.phase: Take the lead early with Nidalee’s fast jungle clear and spear poke, and delay Sejuani’s item timings. Nidalee peaks in the mid game as her ability power builds, so keep up the pressure then. In the late game, Nidalee’s impact falls off if she can’t hit her spear, while Sejuani gets tankier over time, so avoid head-on fights.
Sejuani.teamfight: Don’t go in head-on. Throw Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the side or behind in human form. Dodge Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and Sejuani R Glacial Prison, and go in as Cougar only after the enemy’s main damage dealer has lost enough health to finish them. After engaging, escape with Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce.
Sejuani.watch: When you see the windup for Sejuani Q Arctic Assault or Sejuani R Glacial Prison, move sideways to dodge. If you’re hit by the first strike of Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath, get out of range before the second strike. Sejuani E Permafrost stacks also build from melee allies’ basic attacks, so immediately create distance as the indicator rises.

Shaco.build: In the early game, hold on with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Prioritize magic resistance against the damage from Shaco W Jack In The Box, Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison, and Shaco R Hallucinate.
Shaco.combo: Hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to apply the Hunt mark, then transform with Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar and close in with empowered Nidalee W Pounce. Get into basic attack range, finish with Nidalee Q Takedown, and deal your remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. If your spear misses, you won’t get the empowered effect or the Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar reset, so don’t engage.
Shaco.escape: Engage just after Shaco Q Deceive is down, along a path without Shaco W Jack In The Box. Nidalee W Pounce can also jump over terrain to escape, so think about your exit route before going in. If health has dropped, heal with Nidalee E Primal Surge and retreat while avoiding jungle areas or bushes without vision.
Shaco.fight: Right after you bait out Shaco Q Deceive is an opportunity to close the gap. Hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to apply the Hunt mark, then engage; if it misses, don’t force your way in. Don’t start a fight in a spot where Shaco W Jack In The Box is expected.
Shaco.laning: Nidalee has no way to lock down an opponent, so help lanes where an ally can lock down Shaco first. If there’s no such lane, don’t force ganks; farm the jungle and place Nidalee W Bushwhack traps at river entrances and jungle forks to track Shaco’s path.
