Keep vision at your jungle entrances too, to prepare for Shaco’s early ganks and invades.
Shaco.phase: Early-game Shaco looks for an advantage through ganks and invades, so don’t give him kills; maintain vision and take objectives. Nidalee clears the jungle quickly and is strong in the mid game as her ability power builds, so connect long-range spear hits to fights then. In the late game, Shaco is weaker in isolated fights, but Nidalee’s impact also falls off if she can’t hit her spear, so avoid forcing head-on fights.
Shaco.teamfight: Apply the Hunt mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the side or behind. When Shaco appears after using Shaco Q Deceive to engage, immediately focus your damage with your allies. Identify the clone from Shaco R Hallucinate by how its health bar responds, and move away from the explosion and boxes when it dies. Go in as Cougar to finish only when the main damage dealer has lost enough health, then escape with Nidalee W Pounce.
Shaco.watch: If Shaco Q Deceive gets behind you, his empowered basic attack is dangerous, so if he’s nearby, keep your back to a wall or face toward your allies. Watch out for Shaco W Jack In The Box in bushes without vision and around objectives; check with a Control Ward or Oracle Lens before going in. When your health is low, avoid paths without vision so Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison can’t hit you.

Shyvana.build: Shyvana’s main damage is magic, so start with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Shyvana W Inferno Aegis heals, so include Morellonomicon to counter her healing between fights.
Shyvana.combo: Hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to apply the Hunt mark, then transform with Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. Close in with empowered Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce, finish with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss / Takedown from basic attack range, and deal your remaining damage with Nidalee E Primal Surge / Swipe. If your spear misses, don’t force your way in expecting the empowered effect.
Shyvana.escape: An opportunity to engage comes when Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is down or her Fury bar is empty. Shyvana has no ability to create distance herself, so apply the mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss and chase with Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce. Shyvana is unstoppable while Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is in flight, so don’t try to interrupt the dash; maintain distance from her landing point.
Shyvana.fight: Poke down Shyvana by hitting Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range, and approach with Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce when the mark is applied. Don’t fight up close while Shyvana W Inferno Aegis increases her movement speed; use Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar to return to human form and create distance.
Shyvana.laning: Pressure Shyvana’s jungle early before she can build Shyvana P Scalemail stacks through camps and objectives. Place Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce traps at river entrances and jungle forks to track her path, and try to gank lanes where an ally can lock down the opponent first.
Shyvana.phase: Shyvana has few Shyvana P Scalemail stacks early, making her easier to pressure, and Nidalee can take the lead with her fast jungle clear and spear poke. Nidalee peaks in the mid game as her ability power builds, so consolidate your advantage then. In the late game, Shyvana builds permanent stacks and Nidalee’s presence falls off if she can’t hit her spear, so the longer the game goes, the worse it is for you.
Shyvana.teamfight: After Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, spread out from your allies so her area damage doesn’t overlap across several of you. Nidalee shouldn’t go in head-on; apply the mark by hitting Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the side. Go in as Cougar to finish only when the main damage dealer has lost enough health, then escape with Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce.
Shyvana.watch: Shyvana E Molten Burst slows and deals damage based on maximum health, so create distance after it hits to avoid getting within range of Shyvana Q Emberstrike. When Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is available, watch its dash path and the area of Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, and save Nidalee W Bushwhack / Pounce as a way to escape.

Skarner.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Prioritize magic resistance based on Skarner’s main damage, but this won’t block the physical damage from Skarner Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval and Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. Decide in advance whether to include Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar in your build to prepare for the suppression from Skarner R Impale.
Skarner.combo: Hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to apply the Hunt mark, then transform with Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. While Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, close in with empowered Nidalee W Pounce, use Nidalee Q Takedown from basic attack range, and deal your remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. If your spear misses, you won’t have the empowered effect, so stop your engage.
Skarner.escape: Right after baiting out Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is an opportunity to go in with Nidalee W Pounce. Check the short range of Skarner R Impale and the wall positions before engaging, and use Nidalee W Pounce’s leap over terrain to escape.
Skarner.fight: Keep out of range of the empowered basic attack from Skarner Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval and hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range. Right after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is used, you have an opportunity to close the gap with Nidalee W Pounce, but don’t force your way in if your spear misses.
Skarner.laning: Nidalee has no crowd control, so gank lanes where an ally can lock down the opponent first. If there’s no such lane, gain an advantage by farming the jungle and invading the enemy jungle. Place Nidalee W Bushwhack traps in advance at river entrances and jungle forks to track Skarner’s path.
Skarner.phase: In the early game, use Nidalee’s fast jungle clear and spear poke to take the lead and pressure objectives, delaying Skarner’s item timings. Nidalee peaks in the mid game as her ability power builds, so look for opportunities after hitting a spear instead of fighting head-on. In the late game, Nidalee’s presence falls off if she can’t hit her spear, while Skarner gains both damage and durability from tank items over time.
Skarner.teamfight: Nidalee shouldn’t go in head-on; apply the mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the side or behind. Go in as Cougar to finish only after the main damage dealer has lost enough health and Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, then escape with Nidalee W Pounce. At the edges of the Dragon or Baron pit, Skarner R Impale can pull you in, so don’t stand against the wall.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact charges through terrain and causes a stun on collision with a wall. Don’t stand with your back to a wall, and if you’ve already been hit into a wall, back away while accounting for his next dash. If you’re suppressed by Skarner R Impale, you can’t break free with Nidalee W Pounce, so avoid getting within its short range.

Taliyah.build: Start by getting a Null-Magic Mantle to survive the early game. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots, and build magic resistance since Taliyah’s main damage is magic.
Taliyah.combo: Hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from a distance to mark your hunt, then transform with the reset Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. Use empowered Nidalee W Pounce along a route that avoids the minefield, then finish with Nidalee Q Takedown in basic attack range and deal the remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. If your spear misses, you won’t have the empowered effect, so don’t force an engage.
Taliyah.escape: Look to engage while Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and Taliyah R Weaver's Wall are down. If Taliyah W Seismic Shove is still available, position so she can’t knock you through the minefield, and don’t cross paths covered by the minefield with Nidalee W Pounce. If you haven’t damaged Taliyah yet, account for the possibility that she can escape with Taliyah R Weaver's Wall when you chase.
Taliyah.fight: Poke first from a distance with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss in human form, and dodge Taliyah Q Threaded Volley sideways while managing your distance. If a minefield is laid out, go around it instead of crossing it with Nidalee W Pounce. Constantly damaging Taliyah can also prevent her from escaping with Taliyah R Weaver's Wall.
Taliyah.laning: Nidalee can’t lock down enemies herself, so prioritize ganking lanes where an ally can hold Taliyah. If there are no such lanes, gain an advantage through jungle farming and invading the enemy jungle. When Taliyah disappears from the jungle, prepare to retreat in advance, as she can intervene in other lanes.
Taliyah.phase: Nidalee peaks in the mid game as her ability power builds, so create opportunities by landing spears. In the late game, missing spears reduces your impact, so avoid forced head-on fights.
Taliyah.teamfight: Don’t jump in head-on. Throw Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the flank or behind in human form. Enter in cougar form to finish only after the mark is applied and Taliyah has lost enough health. Save Nidalee W Pounce as an escape tool, and avoid getting caught by Taliyah’s crowd control.
Taliyah.watch: Taliyah Q Threaded Volley can’t change direction while she casts, so dodge sideways instead of approaching in a straight line. Check your engage route first, as using Nidalee W Pounce across the minefield can stun you.

Udyr.build: Work Morellonomicon into your build so Udyr W Iron Mantle’s healing doesn’t cost you a kill opportunity. Build armor first for defense, while keeping in mind that Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals both physical and magic damage, and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deals magic damage.
Udyr.combo: Hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from a distance to mark your hunt, then transform with the reset Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. Close in with empowered Nidalee W Pounce until you’re in basic attack range, finish with Nidalee Q Takedown, and deal the remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. Starting this sequence after Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield is gone helps limit his chance to heal.
Udyr.escape: Save Nidalee W Pounce to disengage when Udyr runs at you with Udyr E Blazing Stampede. After Udyr uses E and lands a stun once, he can’t immediately stun the same target again, so use that opening to retreat or counterattack. Conversely, right after Udyr E Blazing Stampede is down, hitting Nidalee Q Javelin Toss gives you a chance to follow up with empowered Nidalee W Pounce.
Udyr.fight: Poke Udyr from a distance with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss before he can get on top of you. If Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield is gone and he has just used Udyr E Blazing Stampede, you have an opportunity to press the attack. If your spear misses, don’t force an engage expecting empowered Pounce and a form-swap cooldown reset.
Udyr.laning: Place Nidalee W Bushwhack in advance at river entrances and jungle crossroads to track Udyr’s pathing. Don’t push forward while he’s missing, and prioritize ganking lanes where an ally can lock down the enemy. If there are no such lanes, look for an advantage through jungle farming and invading the enemy jungle.
Udyr.phase: Nidalee peaks in the mid game as her ability power builds, so create opportunities with vision and spear hits. In the late game, missing spears reduces your impact, so avoid forced engages.
Udyr.teamfight: Don’t engage head-on. In human form, hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the flank or behind. Rather than targeting Udyr first once his defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle have made him durable, enter in cougar form to finish a weaker enemy in the backline when they have been sufficiently weakened. Consider your escape route with Nidalee W Pounce, and cast Nidalee E Primal Surge on an allied damage dealer just before an objective fight.
Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede closes the gap quickly and stuns the first target it hits, so create distance when he switches stances. If he gets on top of you, you can take damage from Udyr Q Wilding Claw’s max-health damage and empowered basic attacks, as well as Udyr R Wingborne Storm’s slow and area damage. Save Nidalee W Pounce for when the distance closes.

Vi.build: Vi’s main damage from Vi Q Vault Breaker, Vi W Denting Blows, and Vi E Relentless Force is physical, so buy armor items first. Vi W Denting Blows deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid relying on a large amount of health alone.
Vi.combo: After dodging Vi Q Vault Breaker, hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range to apply the Hunt mark. Transform with the reset Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar, close in with empowered Nidalee W Pounce, get into basic attack range, then use Nidalee Q Takedown and Nidalee E Swipe in that order. If your spear misses, you won’t have the empowered effect, so don’t force your way in.
Vi.escape: Bait out Vi Q Vault Breaker and the moment right after you dodge it is an opportunity to engage. If Vi R Cease and Desist is also available, account for the risk of being caught after you go in, and leave room to use Nidalee W Pounce to escape.
Vi.fight: Right after dodging Vi Q Vault Breaker, hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from long range and deal a quick burst of damage. If Vi P Blast Shield is active, wait until it’s removed, and don’t trade for long enough to let Vi W Denting Blows stack.
Vi.laning: Nidalee has no crowd control, so gank lanes where an ally can lock down the opponent first. If Vi’s ability hits a minion and activates Vi P Blast Shield, delay trading until the shield is removed. If there’s no gank opportunity, gain an advantage by farming the jungle and invading the enemy jungle.
Vi.phase: Nidalee peaks in the mid game as her ability power builds, so fight briefly after hitting your spear. In the late game, Nidalee’s presence falls off if she can’t hit her spear, so look for an angle to land it from long range.
Vi.teamfight: Don’t go in head-on; apply the Hunt mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the side or behind. Transform with Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar to finish only after the enemy’s main damage dealer has lost enough health, then escape with Nidalee W Pounce. While Vi R Cease and Desist is available, don’t enter areas without vision alone and stay within range of your allies’ protective abilities.
Vi.watch: Vi Q Vault Breaker deals more damage the longer it’s charged and dashes forward to knock you back, so move back or sideways to dodge when you see her charging. Vi R Cease and Desist chases its target all the way and knocks them up, so don’t enter areas without vision alone while it’s available. If you let her chain attacks, Vi W Denting Blows reduces your armor, so don’t trade with her for long.

Viego.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King and Viego R Heartbreaker. If Viego restores health during a fight with Viego P Sovereign's Domination and Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King, work Morellonomicon into your build.
Viego.combo: Hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from a distance to mark your hunt, then transform with Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. Close in with empowered Nidalee W Pounce until you’re in basic attack range, finish with Nidalee Q Takedown, and deal the remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. If your spear misses, don’t force an engage.
Viego.escape: After dodging Viego W Spectral Maw, look to engage with Nidalee W Pounce when Viego can’t use Viego R Heartbreaker either. If only one of Viego’s mobility spells is down, he can escape with the other, so enter carefully to keep Nidalee W Pounce available for your own escape.
Viego.fight: Dodge Viego W Spectral Maw sideways while first chipping away at his health from long range with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss. Only close in with Nidalee W Pounce when your spear hits, applies the Hunt mark, and Viego’s mobility abilities are down. If you miss, don’t start a head-on duel without the empowered chase.
Viego.laning: Nidalee has no way to lock down enemies, so gank lanes where an ally can hold them first. Don’t push a lane in the direction of visible Viego E Harrowed Path, and place Nidalee W Bushwhack in advance at river entrances and jungle crossroads to track his pathing.
Viego.phase: Nidalee peaks in the mid game as her ability power builds, so look for opportunities after poking with spears. In the late game, missing spears reduces your impact, so avoid skirmishes where Viego can secure a kill.
Viego.teamfight: Avoid head-on engages and apply your mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the flank or behind. Keep your distance where an ally has fallen, as Viego can possess them with Viego P Sovereign's Domination. Only engage with Nidalee W Pounce to finish and escape when the enemy’s main damage dealer has lost enough health.
Viego.watch: Viego W Spectral Maw stuns for longer the more it’s charged, so dodge sideways when you see him charging. If Viego E Harrowed Path is visible across terrain, watch for a camouflaged Viego to engage and go around that area. Retreat when your health is low, as you can become a target for Viego R Heartbreaker.

Warwick.build: In the early game, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Warwick’s main magic damage, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. If fights drag on because of the healing from Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast, and Warwick R Infinite Duress, get healing reduction from Morellonomicon.
Warwick.combo: After Warwick E Primal Howl’s fear triggers, hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from a distance to mark your hunt. Transform with Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar, close in with empowered Nidalee W Pounce, finish with Nidalee Q Takedown in basic attack range, then deal the remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. If your spear misses, you won’t have the empowered effect or a form-swap cooldown reset, so don’t force an engage.
Warwick.escape: Don’t engage just because Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down. Wait until Warwick R Infinite Duress is also down, and engage before it comes back. If Warwick E Primal Howl’s fear has also triggered, apply your hunt with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss or Nidalee W Bushwhack, then close the gap with Nidalee W Pounce.
Warwick.fight: When Warwick E Primal Howl is active, use Nidalee W Pounce to create distance, then look for another opportunity after the fear triggers. Poke from a distance with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss, and enter in cougar form to finish only when Warwick R Infinite Duress is down. Warwick heals more at low health, so don’t dive just because he’s at half health.
Warwick.laning: Nidalee has no crowd control, so gank lanes where an ally can lock down the enemy first. If there are no such lanes, use your fast early jungle clear to gain an advantage through farming or by invading Warwick’s slow clear. If your health falls below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals your location, so recall instead of staying at risk.
Warwick.phase: Early on, use Nidalee’s fast jungle clear and Warwick’s slow clear to get ahead through invades and lane priority. Nidalee peaks in the mid game as her ability power builds, so start favorable fights after landing a spear. In the late game, missing spears reduces Nidalee’s presence, so focus on spear poke and finishing opportunities instead of head-on fights.
Warwick.teamfight: Don’t engage head-on; apply your mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the flank or behind. Warwick R Infinite Duress reaches farther when his movement speed is increased, so during objective standoffs, don’t assume brush without vision or the far side of the pit is safe. Only enter in cougar form to finish after the main damage dealer has lost enough health and Warwick’s crowd control is down.
Warwick.watch: While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, don’t pour out damage; retreat. Its fear can trigger early if he recasts, so don’t stay nearby counting down until it ends. If Warwick R Infinite Duress hits you, you are suppressed and can act, so move outside its leap range and keep in mind that Warwick can reach farther when his movement speed is increased.

XinZhao.build: Work Morellonomicon into your build so Xin Zhao P Determination’s healing doesn’t cost you a kill opportunity. Build armor first to reduce Xin Zhao’s main damage.
XinZhao.combo: Hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from a distance to mark your hunt, then transform with the reset Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. Close in with empowered Nidalee W Pounce until you’re in basic attack range, finish with Nidalee Q Takedown, and deal the remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. If your spear misses, you won’t have the empowered effect, so don’t force your way in.
XinZhao.escape: Dodge the thrust at the end of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning sideways to deny him an extended engage with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Right after Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is used, look for a chance to close the gap with Nidalee W Pounce. If the third hit of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike is still available, leave its range first.
XinZhao.fight: Don’t fight head-on for long; poke Xin Zhao from a distance with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss. Create distance after he uses Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, then engage with Nidalee W Pounce when a spear or Nidalee W Bushwhack applies your hunt mark. If Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, counterattack once the immunity window ends.
XinZhao.laning: Avoid head-on jungle fights with Xin Zhao, and place Nidalee W Bushwhack in advance at river entrances and jungle crossroads to read his pathing. Prioritize ganking lanes where an ally can lock down the enemy. If there are no such lanes, gain an advantage through jungle farming and invading the enemy jungle.
XinZhao.phase: Early on, Nidalee can clear the jungle quickly and pressure with spears, but avoid head-on fights with Xin Zhao. Nidalee peaks in the mid game as her ability power builds, so start fights after landing a spear. In the late game, missing spears reduces Nidalee’s impact, so look for the moment Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends during a team fight.
XinZhao.teamfight: Avoid head-on engages and apply your mark with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the flank or behind. Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard can knock enemies apart, so don’t stand too close to your allies. Only enter in cougar form to finish and escape with Nidalee W Pounce after the enemy’s main damage dealer has lost enough health and Xin Zhao’s immunity window has ended.
XinZhao.watch: Dodge the thrust at the end of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning by moving sideways. If you’ve been hit by two empowered basic attacks from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, use Nidalee W Pounce to leave range before the third hit knocks you up. While Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, keep your distance instead of attacking from outside spear range.

Zac.build: Zac’s main damage is magic and Nidalee has low magic resistance, so start by getting a Null-Magic Mantle. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Work Morellonomicon into your build when Zac heals by picking up his blobs.
Zac.combo: Hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from a distance to mark your hunt, then transform with Nidalee R Aspect Of The Cougar. Close in with empowered Nidalee W Pounce until you’re in basic attack range, finish with Nidalee Q Takedown, and deal the remaining damage with Nidalee E Swipe. If your spear misses, you won’t have the empowered effect, so don’t force an engage.
Zac.escape: Look to engage right after Zac uses Zac E Elastic Slingshot. It’s hard to create distance while caught by Zac Q Stretching Strikes’ knock-up or slowed by Zac R Let's Bounce!, so check whether Zac has used his crowd control before you engage. When you need to escape, use Nidalee W Pounce to cross terrain and create distance.
Zac.fight: Right after Zac is made to use Zac E Elastic Slingshot, look for a chance to close the gap. First hit Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from a distance to mark your hunt, then enter in cougar form after Zac has lost health. If you fight up close for too long, you’ll be exposed to Zac W Unstable Matter, so create distance after finishing him.
Zac.laning: Nidalee has no crowd control, so gank lanes where an ally can lock down the enemy first. If there are no such lanes, don’t force ganks; gain an advantage through jungle farming and invading the enemy jungle. Place Nidalee W Bushwhack in advance at river entrances and jungle crossroads to track Zac’s pathing.
Zac.phase: However, Nidalee is fragile, so avoid prolonged head-on fights with Zac from the early game onward. Nidalee peaks in the mid game as her ability power builds. In the late game, missing spears reduces her impact, so absorb Zac’s engage and then find a spear angle from the flank.
Zac.teamfight: Don’t engage head-on; look to mark your target with Nidalee Q Javelin Toss from the flank or behind. Enter in cougar form to finish only when the enemy’s main damage dealer has lost enough health, then escape with Nidalee W Pounce.
Zac.watch: Zac E Elastic Slingshot has a visible charge, and its landing can knock Nidalee up. If you see him charging behind a wall, move away from his landing spot. Keep your distance to avoid Zac Q Stretching Strikes’ slow and knock-up followed by the max-health damage from Zac W Unstable Matter. Clear Zac’s dropped blobs when you can safely step on them to prevent him from healing.
